test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: 'Smaller'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the paragraph, we have discussed the life of Shakespeare.
 
• Only **option 1** is **smaller** best suits the line: **"Little is known about what he did but eventually he traveled to London England, though much smaller__ than it is today****.**"
 
• As the **comparison** is done between the **size of England** at **that time to today**.
 
• We know that **England **is **large** **nowadays** so in **comparison** it must be **smaller earlier**.​​

**__The correct sentence__**: *Little is known about what he did but eventually, he traveled to London England, though much **smaller** than it is today.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

 
• The words **bigger** and **larger** are **similar**.
 
• The city or place cannot be younger.
